components.name: Button
components.description: Buttons allow users to trigger actions and navigate throughout the application.
components.usage: Use buttons to trigger actions like submitting forms, opening dialogs, or navigating.

components.name: IconButton
components.description: Icon buttons are buttons that only contain an icon without text labels.
components.usage: Use for actions where an icon clearly represents the action, like delete, edit, or close.

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.description: Button groups combine related buttons together.
components.usage: Use to group related actions or to create segmented controls.

components.name: TextField
components.description: Text fields let users enter and edit text with validation support.
components.usage: Use for single-line text input with labels, helper text, and validation.

components.name: Select
components.description: Select components allow users to choose from a list of options.
components.usage: Use when users need to select one or multiple options from a list.

components.name: Autocomplete
components.description: Autocomplete provides suggestions as users type in a text field.
components.usage: Use for searchable dropdowns with many options or when users need suggestions.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Checkboxes allow users to select one or more items from a set.
components.usage: Use for binary choices or to select multiple items from a list.

components.name: Radio
components.description: Radio buttons allow users to select exactly one option from a set.
components.usage: Use when users must select exactly one option from multiple choices.

components.name: Switch
components.description: Switches toggle between two states, on or off.
components.usage: Use for settings that take effect immediately when changed.

components.name: Slider
components.description: Sliders allow users to select a value from a range.
components.usage: Use for selecting numeric values within a range, like volume or brightness.

components.name: DatePicker
components.description: Date pickers allow users to select dates from a calendar interface.
components.usage: Use for date selection in forms, scheduling, or filtering.

components.name: Card
components.description: Cards contain content and actions about a single subject.
components.usage: Use to group related information and make it easily scannable.

components.name: Paper
components.description: Paper provides elevation and background styling for surfaces.
components.usage: Use as a container to create visual hierarchy and separation.

components.name: Accordion
components.description: Accordions contain collapsible panels for organizing content.
components.usage: Use to show/hide sections of related content to reduce page length.

components.name: AppBar
components.description: App bars display information and actions at the top of a screen.
components.usage: Use for navigation, branding, and primary actions.

components.name: Toolbar
components.description: Toolbars are containers for grouping action items.
components.usage: Use within App Bars or as standalone action containers.

components.name: Alert
components.description: Alerts display brief messages for users without interrupting workflow.
components.usage: Use to provide feedback about actions or communicate important information.

components.name: Snackbar
components.description: Snackbars provide brief messages at the bottom of the screen.
components.usage: Use for short-lived messages about application processes.

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Dialogs inform users about tasks and can contain critical information.
components.usage: Use for important interactions that require user attention or decisions.

components.name: Progress
components.description: Progress indicators show the status of ongoing processes.
components.usage: Use to show determinate or indeterminate progress of operations.

components.name: CircularProgress
components.description: Circular progress indicators display progress in a circular format.
components.usage: Use for loading states or indeterminate operations.

components.name: LinearProgress
components.description: Linear progress indicators display progress as a horizontal bar.
components.usage: Use when showing determinable progress or loading states.

components.name: Backdrop
components.description: Backdrops dim the background content to emphasize foreground elements.
components.usage: Use with dialogs, drawers, or other overlay components.

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: Skeletons display placeholder content while data is loading.
components.usage: Use to improve perceived performance during content loading.

components.name: Table
components.description: Tables display sets of data in rows and columns with sorting and filtering.
components.usage: Use to organize and display structured data for scanning and comparison.

components.name: List
components.description: Lists display content in vertical arrangement with optional actions.
components.usage: Use for displaying continuous collections of text or images.

components.name: Chip
components.description: Chips are compact elements representing input, attribute, or action.
components.usage: Use for tags, filters, or representing discrete information.

components.name: Avatar
components.description: Avatars represent users or entities with images, icons, or letters.
components.usage: Use in user profiles, lists, or to represent objects visually.

components.name: Badge
components.description: Badges generate small labels to draw attention to content.
components.usage: Use to show counts, status indicators, or notifications.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Tooltips display informative text on hover or focus.
components.usage: Use to provide additional context or help text for UI elements.

components.name: Typography
components.description: Typography components provide consistent text styling.
components.usage: Use for headings, body text, and other text content with proper hierarchy.

components.name: Divider
components.description: Dividers separate content into distinct groups.
components.usage: Use to create visual separation between content sections.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Tabs organize content into separate views where only one is visible at a time.
components.usage: Use to organize related content that doesn't need to be viewed simultaneously.

components.name: Drawer
components.description: Drawers slide in from the side to provide navigation or content.
components.usage: Use for navigation menus or to show additional content.

components.name: Menu
components.description: Menus display a list of choices on temporary surfaces.
components.usage: Use for action overflow, context menus, or dropdown navigation.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.description: Breadcrumbs show the user's location in the site hierarchy.
components.usage: Use to help users navigate back through hierarchical content.

components.name: Link
components.description: Links navigate users to different pages or sections.
components.usage: Use for navigation between pages or to external resources.

components.name: Stepper
components.description: Steppers display progress through numbered steps.
components.usage: Use for multi-step forms or processes to show progress and navigation.

components.name: Pagination
components.description: Pagination enables navigation through pages of content.
components.usage: Use to break large datasets into manageable pages.

components.name: BottomNavigation
components.description: Bottom navigation bars allow movement between primary destinations.
components.usage: Use for mobile-first navigation between 3-5 top-level views.

components.name: Box
components.description: Box is a wrapper component for most CSS utility needs.
components.usage: Use as a generic container with sx prop for styling.

components.name: Container
components.description: Container centers content horizontally with responsive max-width.
components.usage: Use to contain page content with consistent margins.

components.name: Grid
components.description: Grid creates responsive layouts using a 12-column system.
components.usage: Use for complex responsive layouts with multiple columns.

components.name: Stack
components.description: Stack arranges items vertically or horizontally with consistent spacing.
components.usage: Use for one-dimensional layouts with automatic spacing.

components.name: ImageList
components.description: Image lists display collections of images in organized grids.
components.usage: Use to display photo galleries or image collections.

foundations.name: Colors
foundations.description: Element uses a comprehensive color system with Availity branding.
foundations.usage: Access colors through design tokens for consistent theming.

foundations.name: Typography
foundations.description: Typography system based on Material Design with Availity fonts.
foundations.usage: Use Typography component or theme tokens for consistent text styles.

foundations.name: Spacing
foundations.description: 8px grid system for consistent spacing throughout the design.
foundations.usage: Use theme spacing function for margins and padding.

foundations.name: Elevation
foundations.description: Elevation system using shadows to show depth (0-24 levels).
foundations.usage: Use elevation to create visual hierarchy and separate surfaces.

foundations.name: Breakpoints
foundations.description: Responsive breakpoints for different screen sizes.
foundations.usage: Use breakpoints for responsive design and mobile-first layouts.

foundations.name: Theme
foundations.description: ThemeProvider applies Availity design tokens across the app.
foundations.usage: Wrap app with ThemeProvider for consistent theming.

foundations.name: Icons
foundations.description: Material Design icon system integrated with Element.
foundations.usage: Use icon components for consistent visual language.

foundations.name: Shape
foundations.description: Border radius and shape system for components.
foundations.usage: Use shape tokens for consistent corner rounding.

patterns.name: Form Validation
patterns.description: Consistent form validation with real-time feedback.
patterns.problem: Forms need consistent validation and error messaging.
patterns.solution: Use Element form components with validation libraries.

patterns.name: Data Loading States
patterns.description: Managing loading, error, and empty states for data fetching.
patterns.problem: Users need feedback when data is loading or unavailable.
patterns.solution: Use Progress, Skeleton, and Alert components for different states.

patterns.name: Modal Workflow
patterns.problem: Complex workflows need to be contained without leaving context.
patterns.solution: Use Dialog with Stepper for multi-step processes.

patterns.name: Search and Filter
patterns.description: Search and filtering for data-heavy applications.
patterns.problem: Users need to find specific information in large datasets.
patterns.solution: Combine TextField, Autocomplete, and Chip components for filters.

patterns.name: Responsive Layout
patterns.description: Creating layouts that work across all screen sizes.
patterns.problem: Content needs to adapt to different viewport sizes.
patterns.solution: Use Grid and responsive breakpoints for flexible layouts.

patterns.name: Navigation Patterns
patterns.description: Common navigation patterns for healthcare applications.
patterns.problem: Users need consistent navigation across the application.
patterns.solution: Use AppBar, Drawer, and Tabs for hierarchical navigation.

patterns.name: Data Tables
patterns.description: Displaying and interacting with tabular data.
patterns.problem: Large datasets need sorting, filtering, and pagination.
patterns.solution: Use Table component with built-in sorting and filtering.

patterns.name: Form Layouts
patterns.description: Structuring forms for optimal data entry.
patterns.problem: Forms need logical grouping and clear visual hierarchy.
patterns.solution: Use Grid, Card, and proper field spacing for form layouts.

templates.name: Dashboard Layout
templates.description: Dashboard with metrics, charts, and data widgets.
templates.useCase: Display key metrics and data visualizations.

templates.name: Form Page
templates.description: Multi-section form with validation and submission.
templates.useCase: Patient intake, provider registration, claims submission.

templates.name: List View
templates.useCase: Patient lists, provider directories, claims records.

templates.name: Detail View
templates.description: Detailed information with tabs for organization.
templates.useCase: Patient details, provider profiles, claim details.
